column3: PENDING: a numeric for loop with an integer start, limit or step outside int32 runs as a float loop (FORI/FORL count in int32 or in doubles, lj_meta_for converts): the loop variable is a float where PUC has an integer, and from 2^53 on the loop does not count correctly (math.maxinteger-2 .. math.maxinteger does not end). Modes B and R pass: compiled code and the interpreter agree

PENDING: the gsub block (lines 47-65) ping-pongs C and Lua (foo -> string.gsub -> replacement foo -> ...) and is not bounded here: ccallnest counts pcall/xpcall/resume/close only, PUC bounds every C-boundary call (nCcalls, LUAI_MAXCCALLS=200) and stops with a recoverable "C stack overflow" (PUC counts 197/99); here the real C stack exhausts -> SIGSEGV in every arm, both architectures. The file stays a documented skip (row in tests/t-guarded.tsv) until the bound exists; design: docs/notes/cstack-ccall-bound.md
